title: Bifunctional Derivative of p,p'-Dichlorochalcone. Part II. Synthesis of a Novel Compound 2-[2-Carboxymethylthio-2-(4-chlorophenyl)ethyl]-2-(4-chlorophenyl)-4-thiazolidinone
abstract: The synthesis of 2-[2-carboxymethylthio-2-(4-chlorophenyl) ethyl]-2-(4-chlorophenyl) - 4-thiazolidinone (1) from p, p'- dichlorochalcone using thioglycollic acid in the presence of ammonium carbonate is described. Structural assignment and stereochemistry are discussed.
